decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered and 02C, 03C, Received 15 March 2011, 01, Received 19 January 2011 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the ground floor premises is occupied).

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for restaurant (A3) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times:0600 - 1800 hours Monday to Friday, 0700 - 1700 hours Saturday and 0700 - 1600 Sunday, Public and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the premises at 448 Chiswick High Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - The level of noise emitted from the proposed kitchen extraction, should not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any 24 hour period.

Condition : 6 - A three-stage kitchen extraction system shall be installed prior to the occupation and use of the extension hereby approved. The filters and fans shall be maintained, so that there is no offensive odour detectable at the site boundary.

Condition : 7 - No development shall commence until a written maintenance schedule shall be provided for the ventilation of the premises, and should include details of-	cleaning of grease filters; -	the frequency of inspection and replacement of the filters; -	inspection and servicing of fans. The maintenance schedule shall be approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the extension and shall be implemented accordingly.
description: Change of use from A1 to A3 and erection of a single storey rear infill extension to the premises.
